messages:
carla: FYI we're scheduling a narrow-change window 01:15 UTC to pin runtime v2.3.7 and api v1.7.5. Console will flip a feature flag. Need router parity check for new batching header order. @tom @leah please validate KV handshake on staging. deploy-bot will run a dry-run first.

deploy-bot: dry-run queued in 20m. Freeze enforcement 10m before window. No DB migrations detected.

tom: Ran staged load test. Router started returning sporadic 502s during burst when runtime switched batch kernel. Log: `router: upstream 502 header-order mismatch expected [meta,seq,flags] got [seq,meta,flags]`.

leah: Router-side: parser is strict. I can deploy a tolerant parser flag `router-batch-tolerance=true` and canary to two nodes; it's quick.

carla: Rollback play: if 5xx >0.8% sustained 5m, roll runtime back to v2.3.6 immediately. If still failing, enable router tolerance and consider router rollback. @oncall-sre ok with thresholds?

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I'll create alert (5xx >0.8% for 5m -> #incidents + page). Will add runbook steps for runtime rollback first.

console-eng: We'll add a transient banner and include `router-batch-tolerance=true` in the notes. Also adding a probe that checks header order from console flow.

leah: Canarying tolerance to 2 nodes now. Watching p95 and 5xx; will report in ~6m.

deploy-bot: dry-run finished, canary started (2/2). Full rollout ETA ~18m after green.

tom: Canary looks stable: slight p95 increase (~20ms). No user-facing 5xx. Marking ready.

carla: Locking pin 01:15-01:35 UTC. Release note draft: "runtime v2.3.7 - batching kernel optimizations; api v1.7.5 - header parsing tweaks; router - optional tolerant parser (auto-expire 30m)."

leah: Will tag rollout metadata `#batch-tolerance` and set auto-expire.

oncall-sre: Pager on standby. Escalate if alert fires.

carla: Thanks all, will cutover on schedule. Keep signals to this thread.
